notes.title: Patch Note
notes.notes:
Improvements:

 Ghosts: The skins of the ghosts to beat to get the gold medal have changed.


Fixes:

 The ghosts in some levels have been corrected: City_Bonus3, Western_10, Western_11, Western_12 (in normal & lava modes).
 The online best times table is now more stable and functional again.
 Old obsolete times have been fixed on the levels: City_02, City_03, City_08, City_Bonus03, Western_10, Western_11 and Western_12 (in normal & lava modes).
 Colliders in the levels City_02, Western_03 and Western_13 have been fixed. Especially in lava mode where it was possible to cook unfairly.
 Two spelling mistakes were corrected: in the credits and at the end of the game.

notes.title: Cranked Up Release is out now!
notes.notes:
Cranked Up 1.0.0 is out now!

[previewyoutube=TNsrWBazxzA;full][/previewyoutube]
First of all, we would like to thank all those who participated in the early access of Cranked Up. It's also thanks to you that we could make the game evolve until its final release.
Thanks again and enjoy the game!


News:

 New skins now available!
 All steam achievements now available!


Updates:

 All levels were balanced!
 Camera major improvement
 Some levels were drastically modified: (City:  01, 02, 03, 08)
 Last missing sounds added
 Backgound and animation were added on Western bonus levels.


Improved:

 Sugar total count is finally calibrate.
 Backgound and animation were improved a little on some levels.
 Visibility was improved on some levels with props.
 Some props were improved.
 All levels optimization.
 WorldMap optimization.
 Raining pizza effect polish on every levels.
 Credits scene visually improved.
 Credits containt updated.


Fixes:

 Every killing props were fixed
 Every killzone on every levels were fixed
 All collectibles on every levels on every mode were fixed
 All checkpoints on every levels were fixed
 All elements were fixed on Z axis to fixed gamefeel
 Some levels were fixed the floor is lava in particular
 Elements which rotate were fixed on refresh
 Raining pizza system fixed
 WorldMap new level notification toggle fixed
 WorldMap new biome notification toggle fixed
 WorldMap sliding elements on apparition fixed


Love and sweetness <3

notes.title: Patch Note
notes.notes:
Updates:

 WorldMap progression upgraded (popup new biome + animation)
 Make a specific goal on level for the first time play nice particles!

Levels improved:

 City:  06, 07, 18, Bonus_01, Bonus_02, Bonus_05
 Western:  01, 03, 05, 07, 10, 18, 19, Bonus_02, Bonus_03, Bonus_05
  Multi:  Easy_04

Fixes:

 Fix multiplayer gamepad system + Skin switching in game on Multiplayer.
 Fix bug LevelWestern20 which kicked the player from train in chrono mode only.
 Fix a bug which sometimes prevent the biome switching.
 New font which display Chinese's characters.
 Quality on option now display the correct actual.
 Fix LevelWesternBonus01 wrong unlock popup apparition.
 Fix achievements: "Superdonut!", "Straight into the Cup", "Perfect" and "Ricochets".
 Fix rocket activation bug which was triggered when player was stuck against a wall.
 Fixed a fatal annoying bug that caused the player to appear in an empty level and forced to restart the game.
 Rockets letters no more disappear during the training.
 Hellblades rework: Performances + Reset rotation when reset the level.
